task.title: [M1] Explicit or inherited ordered layer-topology requirements
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M1
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M1-02
**Implementation status:** Implemented and independently QA_PASS; Accepted. All five criteria supported.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex implementer; independent forge_qa_reviewer is separate.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§3.3–3.4, 6/M1 acceptance, 7
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Make exact frame/layer work orders possible without inventing choreography.

**Scope:** Per-frame ordered layer roles, reference/template inheritance and specification diagnostics.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Each required action/view declares frame count and each frame an ordered layer set, roles and applicable registration/anchor/reuse constraints.
- [x] Explicit inheritance records reference hash/revision and mapping completeness; versioned named single-layer templates require explicit scope confirmation.
- [x] Missing counts emit UNDERSPECIFIED_FRAME_COUNT; missing/partly unmapped topology emits UNDERSPECIFIED_LAYER_TOPOLOGY. No silent one-layer default.
- [x] Underspecified targets may produce provisional frame-only lists but cannot be exact work orders, COMPLETE_FOR_DECLARED_SCOPE or export-ready.
- [x] Single-layer versus multipart synthetic declarations yield distinct correct totals before any artwork upload.

## Verification

Explicit/template/reference topology tests including partial mapping, layer order, missing declarations and no-art work-order generation.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. Current executable results and limits are recorded below; this structural task grants no artwork or native approval.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-7 (M1-01; task ID rnecskanbq7j2i8m936ti62p)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Only the stated deliverable; no adjacent milestone implementation or automatic artistic/native acceptance.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

Versioned resolved requirements, explicit/per-frame topology, hash-pinned inventory inheritance, single-layer/v1 named template with exact-scope confirmation, deterministic IDs, counts, diagnostics and CLI resolve. Existing v1 identities remain unchanged.

Source: docs/evidence/rsf8/implementation-manifest.json SHA256 f9a08a6bd65e637044af2f3b0f44576b42861c4f3ac2bb9c245d0a19e00fc3dc. Full commands/results: docs/evidence/rsf8/VERIFICATION.md. Computed examples: docs/evidence/rsf8/examples.json SHA256 65f37331f83ddc840fcb26c94072d80831c209d90093784c70e4c997387e35f1.

CPython 3.14.4: 119 public tests, 14 private tests, 3 schemas (13 valid/55 invalid), installed distribution 119 tests/repeated wheel identical, Rust oracle 11 synthetic + 3 audited pair agreements, native verifier 9 unit tests; all exit 0. Examples 48/48,48/96,mixed48/56; Orc512/1776; Novice body/head912/912. Art UNASSIGNED. Python3.12/3.13 unavailable; full native playback not rerun for this structural task. Existing M0-S/I/N PASS and M0_VERIFIED retained.

Accepted source baseline archive: de960b8fa8482ec22e5938ebb5183dc5a448aa555b7afeffc66bcddc8a71c433. No commit/push. No private assets distributed.

## Independent QA

QA_PASS from configured forge_qa_reviewer, separate context /root/rsf8_independent_qa. Independently executed public119, private14 (no skips), schemas3/13valid/55invalid, installed119/repeated wheel identical, Rust oracle11 and all3 audited pairs AGREEMENT, native verifier9; all exit0 on CPython3.14.4. Recomputed example hashes and verified complete143-file baseline + final8-file implementation manifest. Retested empty parts/views correction: mixed known/unknown work retains null exact totals and PROVISIONAL. No mandatory findings remain. Reviewer made no source or Kaneo edits. Full verdict: docs/evidence/rsf8/QA_REVIEW.md. No artwork/native approval or overall M1 acceptance is implied. Existing accepted M0 gates remain applicable.

comments.content: Independent QA_PASS — /root/rsf8_independent_qa (configured forge_qa_reviewer). All five live criteria supported. next_task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M1
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M1-03
**Implementation status:** Backlog (to-do); planned only, no implementation or verification claimed. Kaneo column is authoritative if later changed.
**Responsible implementer:** Unassigned. Required skill: Authorized engineer for this bounded deliverable; independent reviewer is separate.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§2.3, 3.1, 3.4, 4.3–4.4, 6/M1
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Record exactly which supplied artwork fulfills each ordered requirement and who approved reuse.

**Scope:** Source-hash assignments, transforms/crops, reuse edges, cycle validation and orthogonal review/validity records.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Ledger maps stable part/action/view/frame/layer IDs to exact source hash, crop/transform recipe, revisions and declared reuse; attachment parent/child/anchor links are explicit.
- [ ] Reuse graph detects cycles, invalid/missing references and hash changes; mirroring/transform reuse counts only when explicitly declared and accepted.
- [ ] Missing source, invalid hash, available-but-unapproved art, reused original/classic fallback and runtime unsupported states remain distinct.
- [ ] Source-art effort counts derive only from declared approved reuse; duplicate decoded pixels never imply aesthetic equivalence or newly authored replacement coverage.

## Verification

Graph cycle and broken-edge tests; mixed validation/review/runtime states and explicit versus inferred reuse regression cases.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. No tests, approvals or native runs are claimed by this planning record.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-8 (M1-02; task ID akj2012swhvsebugprsl0v5j)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No automatic visual approval, generated imagery or runtime fallback completion.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code changes / diff: Not implemented by this planning sync.
- Test commands / exit statuses / artifact hashes: NOT_RUN (planning only).
- Milestone gates / limitations: Not evaluated; structural, coverage, visual, preview and native states remain separate.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

Not performed for implementation. Implementer supplies evidence and moves to QA Review; a distinct read-only reviewer records QA_PASS / QA_FAIL / QA_BLOCKED. Operator-only visual/native decisions remain separate. No acceptance is granted by backlog creation.
